title: pennisetum refractum
intro: Pennisetum refractum, commonly known as Eastern fountain grass, is a type of ornamental grass native to China and Korea. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its high content of dietary fiber. The bioactive constituents present in Pennisetum refractum include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential uses of this plant.
